fix_instructions: Remove C1 as a decisive check or redefine it so that its success is contingent upon incorporating at least one of the hidden facts (PF1, PF2, PF3, or PF4). Specifically, ensure that a 'correct' plan must reflect the specific changes introduced by the private facts, such as the shift to on-site meal pickup (PF1), the 7:30 a.m. PDF release (PF2), the nurse hotline (PF3), or the bilingual/printed packet requirements (PF4).
